rules.statement: Newspapers produced to prove advertisements required by section 532 of the Civil Procedure Code are not liable to stamp duty if they are produced by an officer of the Court or someone acting on its behalf, as long as the advertisement is a duty assigned to the Court.
rules.supporting_quote: "The fact that proctors, as a matter of convenience, and in order to expedite their business, have undertaken duties which are strictly incumbent on the Court and its officers, cannot alter the character of these duties. The advertisement of the order and the proof of the advertisement are duties which are assigned to the Court. When a proctor relieves the Court of its duties in this respect, and sees to the advertisement of the order, any document which he produces in proof of the advertisement must be treated as if it were furnished by an officer of the Court to whom the Court had entrusted the duty of carrying out the advertisement. Such a document is clearly not an exhibit, and is not liable to be stamped as such."
